# Position bridge test fixtures

- `anna-karenina.epub`: *Anna Karenina* by Leo Tolstoy, translated by Constance
  Garnett, from Standard Ebooks
  (https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/leo-tolstoy/anna-karenina/constance-garnett).
  Standard Ebooks releases it under the CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain
  Dedication (see `epub/text/uncopyright.xhtml` inside the file).
- `anna-karenina.kepub.epub`: the same book converted with kepubify v4.0.4, the
  version bundled in CWA v4.0.7.
- `anna-karenina-xpointers.json`: CREngine-style XPointers (the form KOReader
  sync clients such as KOReader and Readest send) for every 40th word of the
  EPUB. Generated by `lab/readest-oracle/generate.test.ts`, which runs Readest's
  CFI-to-XPointer converter (pinned by Readest against real CREngine output).
  It is data we produced; no Readest files are included here.
